email.body1:
Amanda, saw AudioEye launched its next-gen platform and posted record 2025 results.

Momentum like that usually means more in-market accounts than the SDR team can follow up on, and good leads sit too long before anyone touches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so your reps spend time in conversations, not the queue: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to AudioEye's top three accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.body2:
Amanda, quick follow-up for AudioEye.

With a new platform and rising compliance demand, response speed is usually what caps booked meetings, not effort. Leads that aren't touched fast go quiet, and reps burn hours on research and writing instead of selling.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent, without adding to your team's workload.
email.body3:
Amanda, last bit of proof for AudioEye.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how AudioEye's reply rate likely compares to other SaaS compliance vendors. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Amanda, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If speeding up follow-up and freeing your reps isn't a priority right now, no problem at all. Timing matters most right after a platform launch, and I know a record year keeps an SDR team busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR team? I will tailor it to AudioEye either way.
